description: This file implements functions and classes for handling variadic tensor operations in the Torch JIT compiler, including identifying list arguments, replacing operations with variadic versions, and managing list mutation removal.

classes.name: VariadicUpdater
classes.description: A class that updates a graph by replacing specific operations with their variadic counterparts, handling list argument identification and mutation safety.

methods.name: identifyListArgIndices
methods.description: Identifies indices of list arguments in a function schema that contain tensor elements.

methods.name: isTensorListConstruct
methods.description: Checks if a node constructs a list of tensors.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::run
methods.description: Executes the update process on the graph, replacing applicable nodes with variadic operations.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::recordSchema
methods.description: Records the schema of an operation node to identify list argument indices.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::getListIndices
methods.description: Retrieves stored list argument indices for a given operation node schema.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::collectOpNodes
methods.description: Recursively collects nodes of a specific operation type within a graph block.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::allListInputsAreValid
methods.description: Checks if all list inputs of a node are valid for transformation.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::insertAllInputsBetween
methods.description: Inserts a range of inputs from a node into an input vector.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::insertIntegerInput
methods.description: Creates and inserts an integer constant input into the graph.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::deleteOpNodeAndLists
methods.description: Deletes an operation node and its associated list nodes if unused.

methods.name: VariadicUpdater::replaceWithVariadicOp
methods.description: Replaces a node with its variadic version if valid.
